package ansiviewer // import "ubunatic.com/loom/examples/ansiviewer/ansiviewer"

Package ansiviewer is experimental; its API may change between releases.
See docs/APIStability.md for the package stability policy.

Package ansiviewer is a small ANSI-aware directory browser example.

FUNCTIONS

func Record(ctx context.Context, out io.Writer, dir string, delay time.Duration, cols, rows int) error
    Record waits delay, renders exactly one frame of the real viewer widget,
    and returns. The caller owns out; no child process or background goroutine
    leaks.

func RecordCommand(ctx context.Context, out io.Writer, delay time.Duration, command string, args ...string) error
    RecordCommand runs command in a private PTY sized like the hosting terminal,
    captures output until delay (or until the command exits), terminates only
    its process group, and waits for the group to be reaped before returning.

func Render(out io.Writer, dir string, cols, rows int) error
    Render writes one deterministic headless frame from the real widget.

func Run(args []string) error
    Run starts the interactive viewer rooted at the optional directory argument.

func New(dir string) (*browser, error)
    New opens dir and returns an interactive viewer widget.


TYPES

type Kind string
    Kind describes the content presentation selected for a path.

const (
	KindText   Kind = "text"
	KindANSI   Kind = "ansi"
	KindBinary Kind = "binary"
	KindImage  Kind = "image"
)
func Classify(path string) Kind
    Classify identifies a file using its extension and a small content sniff.
